questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Project Management Concepts, Life Cycle & Organization Structures in Construction
questions.text: Define a Project. Explain the Project Life Cycle phases (Inception, Planning/Design, Execution/Construction, Commissioning, and Handover). Explain the Project Management Iron Triangle (Scope, Time, Cost, and Quality).

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Project Planning & Scheduling Techniques (Bar Charts, CPM, PERT Network Analysis, Float Calculations)
questions.text: Compare Critical Path Method (CPM - Deterministic) vs. Program Evaluation and Review Technique (PERT - Probabilistic). For a given construction project with 8 activities, draw the AON (Activity on Node) / AOA network diagram, calculate Earliest Start (ES), Earliest Finish (EF), Latest Start (LS), Latest Finish (LF), Total Float ($TF = LS - ES$), Free Float ($FF$), and Independent Float ($IF$). Identify the Critical Path.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Project Planning & Scheduling Techniques (Bar Charts, CPM, PERT Network Analysis, Float Calculations)
questions.text: In a PERT network, the three time estimates (Optimistic $t_o$, Most Likely $t_m$, and Pessimistic $t_p$) for activities are given. Calculate the Expected Activity Duration ($t_e = \frac{t_o + 4t_m + t_p}{6}$) and Variance ($\sigma^2 = \left(\frac{t_p - t_o}{6}\right)^2$). Calculate project expected completion duration $T_e$, standard deviation $\sigma_{cp}$, and the probability of completing the project 3 weeks ahead of scheduled target date $T_s$ using the standard normal distribution table ($Z = \frac{T_s - T_e}{\sigma_{cp}}$).

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: Resource Allocation, Resource Leveling & Project Crashing (Time-Cost Optimization)
questions.text: Explain Time-Cost Trade-Off (Project Crashing). Define Normal Time ($T_n$), Normal Cost ($C_n$), Crash Time ($T_c$), Crash Cost ($C_c$), and Cost Slope ($S = \frac{C_c - C_n}{T_n - T_c}$). Crash a given project network step-by-step to find the Optimum Project Duration and Minimum Total Project Cost considering direct and indirect costs per day.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Construction Equipment Selection, Output Estimation & Plant Management
questions.text: Explain the selection, output calculations, and economic operation of heavy construction equipment: (a) Earthmoving equipment (Excavators, Bulldozers, Scrapers, Motor Graders), (b) Hauling equipment (Dumpers, Trucks), (c) Compaction equipment (Rollers), and (d) Concrete batching and placing equipment (Transit mixers, Concrete pumps).

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Quality Control, Construction Site Safety, Health and Environmental Management
questions.text: Explain Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) in construction projects. Explain Earned Value Management (EVM) parameters: Planned Value ($PV$), Earned Value ($EV$), Actual Cost ($AC$), Schedule Variance ($SV = EV - PV$), Cost Variance ($CV = EV - AC$), Schedule Performance Index ($SPI = EV / PV$), and Cost Performance Index ($CPI = EV / AC$).

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Contract Administration, Tendering Procedures, Bidding Documents & FIDIC Conditions of Contract
questions.text: Explain Dispute Resolution mechanisms in construction contracts according to FIDIC / PPMO: (a) Negotiation, (b) Dispute Adjudication Board (DAB) / Dispute Resolution Board (DRB), (c) Mediation / Conciliation, and (d) Arbitration (UNCITRAL / Nepal Arbitration Act).
